visibility: evaluator_only; never pass this file or its fields to the model

scoring.full_pass: Correct disposition, valid identifier and period, reproducible calculation or justified limitation, source endpoint and as-of citation, and all material caveats; any hard failure overrides a partial score.
scoring.technical_rule: A run status of completed means only that the model returned text. API failures and tool errors are scored independently of answer quality.

Q1.date_rule: 2024 quarterly fiscal spans; distinguish three-month ITR from cumulative ITR and annual DFP
Q1.valid_join: issuer + reference date + fiscal span + scope + filing version
Q1.calculation: operating cash flow divided by or compared with net income, showing levels when earnings are zero or negative
Q1.required_caveat: No conclusion from income alone; cash-flow lines must be present
Q1.deterministic_check: Each compared pair must have the same fiscal span and version

Q2.date_rule: same fiscal span, scope and currency
Q2.valid_join: issuer/chart context to each as-filed account label
Q2.calculation: compare net-income label or named field; do not assume one account code is universal
Q2.deterministic_check: A single unverified code cannot establish both values

Q3.date_rule: 2024 period spans with every available filing version
Q3.valid_join: issuer + fiscal span + scope, comparing versions rather than overwriting them
Q3.calculation: compare operating-cash-flow-to-net-income conclusion across filing versions
Q3.required_caveat: No observed restatement does not prove none exists outside available history
Q3.deterministic_check: Do not mix ITR cumulative and quarter values

Q4.identifier: Via Parque Shopping FII CNPJ 00332266000131 and named property
Q4.valid_join: fund CNPJ + reference date + filing version + property row hash/name
Q4.calculation: 56,508.93 square metres times 0.124 reported vacancy = 7,007.10732 square metres; verify source row before live pass
Q4.required_caveat: reported vacant area is not independently observed physical occupancy
Q4.deterministic_check: area and vacancy fraction come from the same property filing

Q5.valid_join: fund CNPJ + reference date + version + property row
Q5.calculation: report property revenue share 0.979772 and delinquency 0.231726 as separate filed proportions; verify source row
Q5.required_caveat: one property row does not establish fund-wide collections
Q5.deterministic_check: Do not combine revenue reliance and delinquency into one metric

Q6.date_rule: 2025 quarterly filing dates available in coverage
Q6.valid_join: same fund and property only when row identity is validated; select filing version explicitly
Q6.calculation: count available filings and non-null vacancy/delinquency values separately; zero is present, null is missing
Q6.required_caveat: CVM has no stable property identifier, so an unvalidated property trend is unsupported
Q6.deterministic_check: denominator is observed eligible filings, not all calendar quarters by assumption

Q7.date_rule: fixed target year 2025, annual product, early- and late-2024 survey dates
Q7.valid_join: same endpoint, indicator, horizon, statistic and sample basis across vintages
Q7.calculation: late median minus early median in percentage points
Q7.required_caveat: state exact survey dates and no forecast-skill inference
Q7.deterministic_check: do not mix monthly, annual and smoothed products

Q8.identifier: Brazil Focus median 2025 IPCA target and realized 2025 IPCA
Q8.date_rule: last available December 2024 survey versus calendar-year 2025 outcome
Q8.valid_join: target year 2025 and consistent annual percent units
Q8.calculation: published example: 2024-12-06 median 4.59% minus 2025 realized 4.26% = +0.33 percentage points; a later December vintage may differ
Q8.required_caveat: one vintage is not a skill estimate
Q8.deterministic_check: show actual survey date and recompute the gap from returned values

Q9.identifier: Brazil Focus 2020-2025 annual IPCA targets and realized IPCA
Q9.date_rule: predeclare a high-inflation rule and fixed survey horizon for every target year
Q9.valid_join: target year and same survey timing to realized annual IPCA
Q9.calculation: compare revision distributions across regimes with sample counts
Q9.required_caveat: association only; regime rule and small sample sensitivity
Q9.deterministic_check: no regime conclusion from an undefined high-inflation threshold

L1.valid_join: a dated association cannot identify a causal effect
L1.deterministic_check: reject causal wording even if a correlation is observed

L2.identifier: Via Parque Shopping FII and property
L2.date_rule: periodic property snapshots versus later tenant payment events
L2.required_caveat: vacancy and delinquency snapshots cannot attribute tenants' missed payments
L2.deterministic_check: reject causal wording and do not use unrelated FIDC delinquency as evidence

L3.date_rule: individual dated forecasts would be required
L3.valid_join: aggregate medians do not identify participant skill or monetary-policy effects
L3.calculation: no individual ranking or causal estimate
L3.required_caveat: individual vintages and separate identification design needed
L3.deterministic_check: reject invented forecaster identity or policy effect
